outcome: Attitudes towards gentle cesarean birth techniques
cohort: Physicians, nurses, and other care providers on the labor and birth unit of an unspecified hospital
finding: Most labor and birth care providers had positive attitudes towards gentle cesarean birth, with their perceptions influenced by concerns about patient safety and logistical challenges balanced against the perceived benefits of the techniques.
mod_finding: This abstract discusses gentle cesarean techniques, which suggests a focus on cesarean deliveries.
